newsitem.title: USA: Noble says has letter of intent for rig.
newsitem.headline: Noble says has letter of intent for rig.

text.p: Noble Drilling Corp said it has a letter of intent for a drilling contract for an EVA-4000 semisubmersible rig with three operators in the Gulf of Mexico.
The initial contract will be for five years, plus options and Noble said that it anticipates completion of the conversion and delivery of the unit in the first quarter of 1999.
The company has also entered a one-year contract with Mesa Operating Company for the jack-up Noble Bill Jennings in the Gulf of Mexico, which is scheduled to start in the fourth quarter.
The jack-up is undergoing refurbishment and upgrade to 390 feet of water depth capability and the addition of an extended reach cantilever.

Noble also said that its Paul Romano, an EVA-4000 semisubmersible will not be delivered to Shell Deepwater Development Inc, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, until the third quarter of 1998 instead of the scheduled second quarter. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
